notes:
- Now Playing opens with a consistent animation across library sections and restores the toolbar when returning.
- Synchronized lyrics scroll more smoothly, stay clickable, and brighten when hovered.
- Play and Pause appear on playable artwork. The current track has an animated playback indicator on its cover.
- Liquid Glass hover feedback extends across the library, search, settings, and player, with corrected spacing and clipping.
- Home has more room beside the scrollbar, and Albums has a gap below the header.

Requires macOS 27 or later on Apple silicon. The app archive is ad-hoc signed.
